description: The deposit describes four reservoir release scenarios combining continuous or pulsed flood discharge with different ecological and power-generation priorities. This resource is provided by Hang Wan. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence terms are linked in the provider metadata and require reading before reuse. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The metadata does not establish the dam identity, input period or operational adoption. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
